DeepSeek just dropped deepseek-harness, an open-source agent execution environment built entirely on a modular everything-is-a-plugin architecture! 🚀

Are you tired of monolithic, tightly coupled AI agent runtimes that make it impossible to swap out tools or memory systems without breaking your entire codebase? 

DeepSeek Harness solves this by providing a modular, extensible execution framework where every component—from UI elements to agent logic—operates as an independent, plug-and-play extension.

🔥 Key Features:
• Built on top of Cordis for high spatiotemporal composability
• Out-of-the-box local Web UI launched via NPX or source checkout for immediate agent interaction
• Extensible plugin ecosystem supported by a dedicated GitHub topic discoverability system
• Comprehensive developer tooling with robust Makefile targets, pnpm scripts, and dedicated guidance for autonomous agents

💡 Why developers care:
It completely eliminates monolithic agent codebases. Teams can now swap out tools, memory systems, user interfaces, and execution logic independently via plugins. Use it to rapidly prototype complex multi-agent systems, build custom agent-driven web applications, or package specialized AI capabilities into reusable open-source plugins.

🔗 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness

Turn text prompts into interactive 3D mechanical simulations complete with exploded views, real-time telemetry, and automated video generation using Claude Code! 🛠️✨

Are you tired of trying to explain complex mechanical systems or hardware logic using flat, dry text and static diagrams? 

Meet Teardown (https://github.com/elvarofficial/teardown), a powerful Claude Code skill that bridges conversational AI with 3D physical visualization. It instantly translates conceptual technical questions into fully self-contained, interactive offline HTML simulators.

Here is what makes it a game-changer for your workflow:
• Self-Contained Simulators: Generates single-file offline HTML files featuring a functioning 3D machine, live telemetry panels, interactive exploded part views, and autonomous self-touring logic.
• Programmatic Build Script: Leverages Three.js and inlined assets to compile robust simulators seamlessly from component parts.
• Automated Video Export: Features a frame-by-frame capture engine that renders simulations out to smooth 60 fps MP4 videos, complete with procedurally timed audio mastered to professional LUFS standards.

Whether you are an AI engineer, technical educator, or frontend developer, you can use Teardown to instantly prototype interactive documentation for hardware, engines, or complex state machines. Turn text prompts into engaging visual assets for your next presentation, tutorial, or product launch! 🚀

👉 Check out the repo and try it out today: https://github.com/elvarofficial/teardown

Tired of digging through outdated government portals and scattered forums just to figure out how to relocate abroad? 🗺️💻

Navigating international immigration as a software engineer or digital nomad shouldn't feel like a full-time job. Between EU Blue Card salary thresholds, changing digital nomad visa rules, and complex tax requirements, tech professionals waste countless hours trying to synthesize fragmented policies.

Meet BryceYuuu/RUN: a comprehensive open-source relocation manual featuring 110 pathways across 36 European countries and global destinations built specifically for tech talent and remote workers. 🚀

Here is why you need to bookmark this repository right now:

🌍 36 European Country Profiles: Get structured data on living costs, average salaries, income taxes, and permanent residency timelines.
🎯 Tailored Pathways: Clear categorization for digital nomads, skilled workers, students transitioning to tech roles, and entrepreneurs.
⚡ Real-Time Tracking: Stay ahead of rapidly changing immigration laws, policy updates, and regulatory adjustments.
📋 Step-by-Step Breakdowns: Access detailed procedural flows, key financial figures, and exact documentation lists without the bureaucratic fluff.

Whether you are calculating eligibility for a German Blue Card, comparing tech worker visas in the Netherlands, or researching digital nomad requirements in Southern Europe, this repository gives you the factual reference guide you need to plan your next career move. 

👉 Check it out and star the repo here: https://github.com/BryceYuuu/RUN

Give your AI agents their own private Mac sandbox—without risking your host machine! 🍏🤖

Building computer-use agents or running automated testing usually means risking your main desktop, dealing with messy setups, or struggling with heavy virtualization. 

terminal-mac (https://github.com/govijr/terminal-mac) solves this by letting you render an entire isolated macOS virtual machine directly inside your terminal using Apple Virtualization and high-performance TUI graphics. 

Here is why AI engineers and developers are loving it:

⚡ Native Apple Silicon Performance: Spin up a real, fully isolated macOS guest instance complete with its own apps, files, and permissions in seconds.
🖥️ Blazing Fast TUI Streaming: Stream the guest screen directly into modern terminals like Kitty, Ghostty, or iTerm2 at up to 30fps using shared memory and lz4 compression.
🔌 Built-in MCP Server: Expose a comprehensive Model Context Protocol server giving AI agents deterministic programmatic tools—like screenshots, clicks, dragging, scrolling, and key injections—via simple JSON-returning CLI commands.
🔒 Safe Sandbox Isolation: Perfect for automated UI testing, end-to-end software verification, and deploying autonomous coding agents with zero risk of host security or clipboard interference.

It integrates seamlessly into MCP-compatible clients like Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code. 

Check out the repository and give your agents a proper sandbox today:
https://github.com/govijr/terminal-mac

Stop fighting the temporal inconsistencies and high costs of traditional AI video generators. 🎬🤖

Meet claude-animated-shorts: a powerful new open-source pipeline that lets you generate viral 2D-in-3D animated storytelling shorts entirely locally using Claude, Three.js, and Remotion.

The Problem It Solves:
Creating vertical animated story shorts at scale is usually tedious and fragmented. This project automates the end-to-end production workflow by combining Claude as an orchestration agent with programmatic rendering stacks, covering scriptwriting, storyboard planning, 3D world styling, audio mixing, and automated frame-by-frame quality assurance.

Notable Features:
✨ Claude Code Integration: Custom skill configurations execute automated multi-step video pipelines directly.
🎨 2D-in-3D Stylized Rendering: Combines ink outlines, painted textures, lens blur, and gliding camera paths using Three.js inside Remotion.
🔍 Automated QA Helpers: Includes reference frame comparison tools to evaluate visual quality before final 2K rendering.
🎧 Pro Audio Post-Production: Handles synthesized sound effects, background scores, audio ducking, and loudness normalization seamlessly.

Developer Value:
Gain a complete blueprint for turning LLMs into autonomous creative directors. By combining deterministic rendering frameworks with AI orchestration, you bypass unpredictable video models and secure total programmatic control over camera angles, styling, and asset generation.

Check out the repository here:
https://github.com/mromidev/claude-animated-shorts
